column1: # key, category, mapID, x, y (0-100), English name (dev only), areaID, dungeon finder ids, instance map id, container override
# Dungeon finder ids: GetLFGDungeonInfo's, comma-separated (an instance the finder splits, like Dire Maul's wings,
# has several); the picker reads each one's minimum level from the client. Empty: the client has no entry (AQ, Naxx).
# Instance map id: the group finder's (C_LFGList activities' mapID); the picker shows the level range it suggests,
# and falls back to the dungeon finder's minimum where the group finder has no activity for it (raids, for now).
# Positions are Wowhead's map markers converted by tools/convert_worldmap.py: good to a few
# hundred yards. Fill in the area id once `/mzdump areas <id>` shows the client's name for it.
# City of Dalaran and Excavation Site: Wetlands are Leatrix Maps' dungeon icons instead (Wowhead's were off); not yet
